title: Addresses
description: Your saved shipping and billing addresses, on every site you sign in to.

help.title: About Addresses
help.overview: Your address book: the shipping and billing addresses you save are yours, and every shop and site you sign in to offers them at checkout. A shop never sees your address book, only the address you choose for its order.

sections.title: Fields
items: Type (billing or shipping), first and last name, street, city, country and the map pin are required; email, phone, state, postal code and a label are optional.
Country, state and postal code are what a shop's tax and shipping zones match at checkout.

sections.title: Default addresses
sections.body: You have at most one default address per type.
items: Setting a default clears the previous default of the same type.

sections.title: Orders keep their own copy
items: An order copies the address you pick, so changing or deleting an address later never changes past orders.
Deleting an address can be undone with Restore.
